$comment: Strict contract (D-27, one-way) for flops_report.json — the per-run FLOPs measurement artifact written by the pipeline into each run's own output directory (PIPE-01; produced by pipeline/flops_counter.py from a pre-training calibration forward pass, hooks removed before training). Ratified at the 07-01 Task-1 checkpoint (maintainer decision publish-as-derived, 2026-10-11): the v1 field names are immutable downstream contract consumed by the Phase 11 monitor and the leaderboard efficiency axis. Shape is strictly ADDITIVE over the legacy writer (D-02): every legacy key is present unchanged, plus schema_version (D-27), uncovered_layers (D-03), and the OPTIONAL hardware section (D-05 — present only when captured; each field nullable so CPU/NPU runs record nulls rather than lying; gpu_device is the verbatim torch.cuda.get_device_name() string, no enum mapping). layer_details maps layer names to per-layer FLOPs from the LAST calibration forward (legacy overwrite-per-pass semantics); values are typed number rather than integer because the verbatim HyenaFilter FFT formula yields fractional FLOPs (math.log2 terms) — integer values remain the common case and validate identically. uncovered_layers lists every parameter-owning module no dispatch branch hooked (D-03: loud, never silently under-counted). The artifact is machine-specific and NOT committed (D-26); consumers validate tolerantly-read documents against this schema.
